responsibility: This file implements quiet-aware formatted printing for mc. Each qprintf routine consults mcOptions.getQuiet and forwards to the corresponding mcPrintf function only when informational output is enabled, making it the driver and pass scheduler’s standard path for optional progress messages rather than hard diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the mcQuiet pair: it imports mcOptions.getQuiet and mcPrintf, checks the quiet flag, and conditionally forwards each qprintf call, whereas mcQuiet.def only publishes those procedure signatures.
